adaptationRules: Original source text remains untouched; new story copy lives in proposal manifests.
Chapter04 repeated prose is one afternoon sequence, not two days.
Physical actions, reactions and changes of place need coverage; no fixed image quota.
Abstract ideas should become understandable through small exchanges/observations; new demonstrations are labeled adaptation additions.
Illustrated references and camera maps guide consistency but are not calibrated 3D geometry.
Internal production acceptance is distinct from Miguel's final approval.
